name: PS5VR
description: Native VR video player for PS VR2 on jailbroken PS5: 8K, 180/360, 3D, spatial audio
author: Husam Osman
release_notes:
New in 1.2.0
- Play a link from your phone: the TV home screen now shows a QR code. Scan it, paste any direct video link (.mp4, .mkv and so on), pick the video type if you want, and press Play. It starts in the headset straight away, no typing on the console. Sending a new link while something plays switches to it.
- PS VR2 Sense controllers (experimental): the controllers show up in VR with a laser pointer for the menus. Trigger to select, drag to scroll, circle to go back, Options for the View menu.
- Hands & eyes is now four modes (experimental, off by default): Hands (point and pinch, with your hands drawn in VR), Eyes + pinch, and Eyes + blink: look at something, keep your eyes closed until the headset buzzes, open them, and it's selected. No hands needed.

The controllers and Eyes + blink are brand new. If they don't behave, please open an issue and say which mode you were using.

Install / update
- Unzip PS5VR-1.2.0-PPSA99177.zip and copy the PPSA99177 folder to /data/homebrew/ (replace the old one).
- Send ps5vr-helper.elf to your ELF loader on port 9021 (or add it to your autoload list).

Checksums (SHA-256), official builds only come from this page:
- PS5VR-1.2.0-PPSA99177.zip 8e39a7ecb8fa2519291e892600dda43b85325c52a9ff7ab029bb78c38a16765d
